summary.text: Gary Howell is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates, representing District 87, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his tenure as beginning in 2010, and he is a business owner.

paragraphs.text: Gary Howell was born in Cumberland, Maryland, graduated from Keyser High School, and earned an associate degree and a bachelor's degree in management from Frostburg State University.
His career experience includes working as a small business owner.
Howell has represented District 87 since December 1, 2022, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
In the 2023-2024 session he chaired the Economic Development Committee and also served on the Finance, Political Subdivisions and Rules committees, according to Ballotpedia.
